single.rationale: CMC faces severe cyclical headwinds with net income collapsing 93% from $1.2B (FY2022) to $85M (FY2025) and ROE at only 2%, while trading at 75x P/E. Despite capital investments in micro mills and strategic acquisitions totaling ~$2.5B, the company operates in a highly commoditized steel market with extreme margin compression and significant execution risks around new capacity ramp-up during a weakening demand environment.
